crossRefs.note: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant…
God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all…
Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from…

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
translations.bsb: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
translations.kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
translations.asv: even he to whom it was said, In Isaac shall thy seed be called:
